title: ThreadSpace
tagline: Captain a frigate you can walk around in: fly her, launch her fighter, board a pirate ship and trade between three sectors.
readinessNote: Plays end to end: a 10–15 minute campaign loop and seeded drop-in missions. Sectors, goods, upgrades, crew and mission offers are data tables in src/data.mjs, but each mission kind's rules and every drop-in template live in code (game.mjs, mission.mjs).
buildYourOwn: New sectors, stations, goods, crew to hire, upgrades and mission offers (src/data.mjs); new mission kinds and drop-in templates (code); the Kestrel's shape and rooms through the in-game shipyard.
